responsibility: Maintains target and function register metadata used by RTL passes and allocation. It initializes hard-register sets, class contents, allocation order, register names, and global-register state; provides register-class queries and regscan support; and builds caches describing which hard registers can realize SUBREG shapes or partial subregister updates via valid mode changes. It is the central implementation file for low-level register information tables rather than a scheduling or allocation algorithm itself.
